items.verse: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًۭا مَّحْسُورًا
items.verseEn: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
Have We not made for him two eyes?

items.verse: فَلَوْلَآ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا۟ وَلَـٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
items.verseEn: Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing.

items.verse: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
items.verseEn: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].

categories.name: جُمُوعُ التَّكْسِيرِ عَلَى وَزْنِ فُعَلَاءَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Broken plurals of the pattern فُعَلَاء in the Quran

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
items.verseEn: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.

items.verse: وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ
items.verseEn: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"

items.verse: إِن تُبْدُوا۟ ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِىَ ۖ وَإِن تُخْفُوهَا وَتُؤْتُوهَا ٱلْفُقَرَآءَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنكُم مِّن سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
items.verseEn: If you disclose your charitable expenditures, they are good; but if you conceal them and give them to the poor, it is better for you, and He will remove from you some of your misdeeds [thereby]. And Allāh, of what you do, is [fully] Aware.

items.verse: وَلَا تُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلسُّفَهَآءَ أَمْوَٰلَكُمُ ٱلَّتِى جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَـٰمًۭا وَٱرْزُقُوهُمْ فِيهَا وَٱكْسُوهُمْ وَقُولُوا۟ لَهُمْ قَوْلًۭا مَّعْرُوفًۭا
items.verseEn: And do not give the weak-minded your property, which Allāh has made a means of sustenance for you, but provide for them with it and clothe them and speak to them words of appropriate kindness.

categories.name: فِئَاتُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Categories of Wrongdoers in the Quran

items.verse: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
items.verseEn: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.

items.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُوَلِّى بَعْضَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعْضًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
items.verseEn: And thus will We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they used to earn.

items.verse: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
items.verseEn: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.

items.verse: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
items.verseEn: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters.

categories.name: صِيغَةُ فَعَّالٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Adjectives of the pattern فَعَّال in the Quran

items.verse: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌۭ ۖ جَحَدُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا۟ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
items.verseEn: And that was ʿAad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.

items.verse: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
items.verseEn: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."

items.verse: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
items.verseEn: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."

items.verse: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
items.verseEn: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

harf.hint: A fruit that grows on a vine, often mentioned alongside dates in the Quran
harf.arabicVerse: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًۭا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
harf.verse: 16:67 - And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.

deduction.title: The Slumber Beyond Time
deduction.intro: Imagine a time when truth was silenced and believers were hunted. A small group chose retreat over surrender, finding refuge in the most unlikely of places — a place that would become their resting ground for centuries beyond counting. When they finally awoke, the world had transformed around them. Who are these slumbering souls?
clues: We were young people living in an ancient city.
Our community demanded that we worship alongside them, but we refused.
We fled the city in search of refuge from those who opposed our beliefs.
A loyal four-legged companion stayed at the entrance of our hiding place.
Allah caused us to sleep for three hundred and nine years.
When we finally awoke, our once-persecuting city had embraced faith.

identity.label: Who Are We?
options: Ashab al-Kahf (The People of the Cave)
Ashab al-Fil (The Army of the Elephant)
Ashab al-Ukhdud (The Companions of the Trench)
The Hawariyyun (Disciples of Isa)
Yajuj wa Majuj (Gog and Magog)
identity.answer: Ashab al-Kahf (The People of the Cave)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: We retreated into a cave and slept for centuries
We were saved from a blazing fire
We were swallowed by a great fish
We were tested with a miraculous she-camel
We were given nine clear signs
trial.answer: We retreated into a cave and slept for centuries

location.label: Key Element
options: A deep cave in the mountains
A boat on the open sea
A towering structure reaching the heavens
A garden divided between two rivals
A barrier of iron and copper
location.answer: A deep cave in the mountains

outcome.label: Outcome
options: We awoke to find our city had turned to faith
A blazing fire became cool and peaceful
An enemy army was drowned in the sea
Birds carrying stones destroyed the foe
A great fish released us onto the shore
outcome.answer: We awoke to find our city had turned to faith

deduction.arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
deduction.verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)

scramble.hint: This closing verse of Surah Ar-Rahman extols Allah's majestic and honorable attributes, frequently recited in remembrance and supplication.
scramble.arabic: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
scramble.verseEn: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
